paragraphs: Pay Tel describes an in-house technology team developing solutions for confinement facilities, incarcerated persons, and the families it serves.

Under Products and Services the site lists InteleTABLET, a multi-function tablet providing services to facilities and detainees, and Centurion ITS, a communications platform with call control, administrative, and investigative capabilities. The same list names inteleVISIT, web-based on-site and remote video visitation, and InteleSCAN, an off-site mail scanning solution.

A further offering is Pathway to Achieve, presented as a free education platform created to change lives and help reduce recidivism. That platform is described as including a self-administered Risk/Need Assessment and courses chosen for detainees, aimed at basic education, practical skills, and behavioral change. A section headed Pay Tel Clients In The News carries reports naming Forsyth County Detention Center, Dorchester County, Crisp County, Jackson County, and a Wilkes jail.

quote.text: Improving lives and lifting communities through reliable communications, life-changing education and meaningful reentry resources.
